text: Ward 16 Eglinton-Lawrence consists of many local parks, schools, day cares, and senior's homes. Residents have asked that I do everything I can to make our roads safer, particularly for our youth and seniors. It is for this reason, I am requesting that all local roads in Ward 16 that are currently 50km/hr are reduced to 40km/hr. This approach has been adopted in other wards throughout the City and I would ask that you support my request to make the same change.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50km/hr to 40km/hr on all local roads within the boundaries of Ward 16, excluding those roads that bound other wards or Community Council areas. 2. Authorized the appropriate City staff to take the necessary action to implement the foregoing reduction in speed limit, including the introduction of necessary Bills to North York Community Council. 3. Requested Transportation Services to report back in July 2018 with recommendations as to whether to lower the speed limit to 40km/hr on any or all of the Collector or Minor Arterial Roads in Ward 16.
